name: Docker (Docker-in-Docker, RHEL)
description: Creates child containers using a dedicated Docker daemon inside the dev container. Installs Docker from the official static Linux binaries.

version.description: Select a Docker CE Engine and CLI version, or use latest.

moby.description: Install Moby instead of Docker CE. Moby RPMs are not available for UBI 10, so true is unsupported.

mobyBuildxVersion.description: Install a specific Docker Buildx version, or use latest.

dockerDashComposeVersion.description: Install the Docker Compose v2 CLI plugin, or disable it with none.

installDockerBuildx.description: Install the Docker Buildx CLI plugin.

installDockerComposeSwitch.description: Install a docker-compose compatibility wrapper that invokes Docker Compose v2.

azureDnsAutoDetection.description: Automatically configure the Docker daemon DNS server when Azure DNS is detected.

dockerDefaultAddressPool.description: Set Docker's default address pool, for example base=192.168.0.0/16,size=24.
